facts.t: Octopuses have three hearts: two pump blood through the gills and one pumps it to the rest of the body.
Honey's low moisture and natural acidity make it extremely resistant to spoilage, which is why sealed honey can keep for years.
A single rotation of Venus takes about 243 Earth days, longer than the 225 days it takes to orbit the Sun.
Botanically, bananas are berries, while strawberries are not.
Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings.
Sharks are older than trees: the earliest shark-like fish appeared over 400 million years ago, before the first forests.
The Sundarbans, shared by Bangladesh and India, is often described as the largest mangrove forest in the world.
Hilsa (ilish) is the national fish of Bangladesh; the national fruit is the jackfruit and the national flower is the shapla (water lily).
UNESCO proclaimed 21 February International Mother Language Day in 1999, honouring the 1952 Language Movement in Bangladesh.
Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
Rabindranath Tagore was the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature, in 1913.
Tagore wrote the words of the national anthems of both Bangladesh and India.
Lalbagh Fort in Dhaka was begun in 1678 and never fully completed.
Somapura Mahavihara at Paharpur, a Buddhist monastery built in the 8th century under Dharmapala, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Dhaka became the capital of Mughal Bengal in 1610.
Grameen Bank and its founder Muhammad Yunus shared the 2006 Nobel Peace Prize.
The Padma Bridge, crossing the Padma river, opened to traffic on 25 June 2022.
The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from space, despite the popular claim.
Ada Lovelace published what is often considered the first algorithm intended for a machine in 1843.
The word 'robot' comes from the Czech word 'robota' (forced labour) and was popularised by Karel Čapek's 1920 play R.U.R.
Mount Everest's height was officially remeasured in 2020 by China and Nepal at 8,848.86 metres.
Water covers about 71% of Earth's surface.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Jamdani, the fine hand-woven fabric of the Dhaka region, is recognised by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.
Pohela Boishakh, the Bengali New Year, falls on 14 April in Bangladesh.
Challenger Deep, the deepest known point of the oceans, lies nearly 11 kilometres below the surface.

riddles.q: What has keys but can't open locks?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
What has hands but can't clap?
What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
What has a neck but no head?
I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
What has many teeth but cannot bite?
What belongs to you but is used more by others?
What is full of holes but still holds water?
